#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""More semantic edge cases, checked against brute force."""
import json, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
from analyze import parse_request, solve
from brute import brute, compare
from difftest import check_witness

def O(i, metric, target, lo, hi, dom=None):
    return dict(id='o%d'%i, metric=metric, target=target, lower=lo, upper=hi, domain=dom)

CASES = []

# fractional loads with integer observation windows
CASES.append(('frac_windows', dict(id='t', version=1, nodes=['A','B','C'],
    edges=[dict(id='ab',source='A',target='B',capacity=100),
           dict(id='bc',source='B',target='C',capacity=100),
           dict(id='ac',source='A',target='C',capacity=100)],
    commodities=[dict(id='AC',source='A',target='C',
        routes=[dict(edges=['ab','bc'],weight=1),dict(edges=['ac'],weight=2)])],
    domains=['d'], max_faults=1,
    snapshots=[dict(id='s', bounds=[[0,7]], controller=[0], tolerance=0,
        observations=[O(0,'link','ab',1,1,'d'), O(1,'link','ac',2,4,None)])])))

# same domain, two contradictory observations in one snapshot -> one fault
CASES.append(('same_domain_conflict', dict(id='t', version=1, nodes=['A','B'],
    edges=[dict(id='ab',source='A',target='B',capacity=100)],
    commodities=[dict(id='AB',source='A',target='B',routes=[dict(edges=['ab'],weight=1)])],
    domains=['d'], max_faults=1,
    snapshots=[dict(id='s', bounds=[[6,6]], controller=[6], tolerance=0,
        observations=[O(0,'link','ab',3,3,'d'), O(1,'link','ab',6,6,'d')])])))

# k=2 out of 3 domains, several optimal masks
CASES.append(('k2_masks', dict(id='t', version=1, nodes=['A','B'],
    edges=[dict(id='ab',source='A',target='B',capacity=100)],
    commodities=[dict(id='AB',source='A',target='B',routes=[dict(edges=['ab'],weight=1)])],
    domains=['a','b','c'], max_faults=3,
    snapshots=[dict(id='s', bounds=[[0,9]], controller=[0], tolerance=9,
        observations=[O(0,'link','ab',1,1,'a'), O(1,'demand','AB',2,2,'b'),
                      O(2,'ingress','A',3,3,'c')])])))

# forced subset differs from possible set
CASES.append(('forced_vs_possible', dict(id='t', version=1, nodes=['A','B','C'],
    edges=[dict(id='ab',source='A',target='B',capacity=2),
           dict(id='bc',source='B',target='C',capacity=5)],
    commodities=[dict(id='AC',source='A',target='C',routes=[dict(edges=['ab','bc'],weight=1)])],
    domains=['x','y'], max_faults=2,
    snapshots=[dict(id='s1', bounds=[[0,9]], controller=[1], tolerance=0,
        observations=[O(0,'link','ab',0,0,None), O(1,'link','bc',4,4,'x')]),
                     dict(id='s2', bounds=[[0,9]], controller=[0], tolerance=0,
        observations=[O(0,'link','ab',1,1,'x'), O(1,'link','bc',7,7,'y')])])))

# trusted contradiction across snapshots -> infeasible even with budget
CASES.append(('trusted_cross', dict(id='t', version=1, nodes=['A','B'],
    edges=[dict(id='ab',source='A',target='B',capacity=100)],
    commodities=[dict(id='AB',source='A',target='B',routes=[dict(edges=['ab'],weight=1)])],
    domains=['d'], max_faults=1,
    snapshots=[dict(id='s1', bounds=[[5,5]], controller=[0], tolerance=0,
        observations=[O(0,'link','ab',4,4,None)]),
        dict(id='s2', bounds=[[0,3]], controller=[0], tolerance=0,
        observations=[O(0,'link','ab',9,9,None)])])))

# capacity forces zero, observation expects positive -> domain faulty
CASES.append(('cap_forces', dict(id='t', version=1, nodes=['A','B'],
    edges=[dict(id='ab',source='A',target='B',capacity=0)],
    commodities=[dict(id='AB',source='A',target='B',routes=[dict(edges=['ab'],weight=1)])],
    domains=['d'], max_faults=1,
    snapshots=[dict(id='s', bounds=[[0,10]], controller=[0], tolerance=0,
        observations=[O(0,'link','ab',3,3,'d')])])))

# weight sum < 8 with three routes
CASES.append(('three_routes', dict(id='t', version=1, nodes=['A','B','C','D'],
    edges=[dict(id='ab',source='A',target='B',capacity=100),
           dict(id='bd',source='B',target='D',capacity=100),
           dict(id='ac',source='A',target='C',capacity=100),
           dict(id='cd',source='C',target='D',capacity=100),
           dict(id='ad',source='A',target='D',capacity=100)],
    commodities=[dict(id='AD',source='A',target='D',
        routes=[dict(edges=['ab','bd'],weight=1),dict(edges=['ac','cd'],weight=1),
                dict(edges=['ad'],weight=3)])],
    snapshots=[dict(id='s', bounds=[[0,10]], controller=[5], tolerance=2,
        observations=[O(0,'demand','AD',5,5,None)])])))

# zero commodities but link observations with domains
CASES.append(('no_coms_obs', dict(id='t', version=1, nodes=['A','B'],
    edges=[dict(id='ab',source='A',target='B',capacity=0)], commodities=[],
    domains=['d1','d2'], max_faults=1,
    snapshots=[dict(id='s', bounds=[], controller=[], tolerance=0,
        observations=[O(0,'link','ab',0,0,'d1'), O(1,'ingress','A',1,1,'d2'),
                      O(2,'egress','B',0,0,None)])])))

bad = 0
for label, raw in CASES:
    inst = parse_request(json.loads(json.dumps(raw)))
    act = solve(inst)
    exp = brute(inst)
    errs = compare(exp, act)
    if exp['status'] in ('unique','ambiguous'):
        try:
            check_witness(inst, act['witness'], act['min_faults'])
            if exp['status']=='unique':
                if act['alternative'] is not None: errs.append(('alt-not-null',1,0))
            else:
                if act['alternative'] is None: errs.append(('alt-missing',1,0))
                else:
                    check_witness(inst, act['alternative'], act['min_faults'])
                    if act['witness']['demands']==act['alternative']['demands']:
                        errs.append(('alt-same',1,0))
        except AssertionError as e: errs.append(('witness', str(e)[:200],''))
    if errs:
        bad += 1
        print('FAIL %-22s %s' % (label, errs))
        print('  exp', json.dumps(exp)[:700])
        print('  act', json.dumps(act)[:700])
    else:
        print('ok   %-22s %s k=%s forced=%s possible=%s' % (label, act['status'],
              act.get('min_faults'), act.get('faults',{}).get('forced'),
              act.get('faults',{}).get('possible')))
print('%d cases, %d failures' % (len(CASES), bad))
PYEOF
